FAQ

Common questions

What should I expect on a first visit?

Plan to arrive a few minutes early. Your practitioner begins with a short conversation about comfort, focus, and any preferences for the ritual.

How do I choose between massage and facial care?

Choose the intention that feels most useful today. The booking flow describes each ritual, and your practitioner can refine the visit when you arrive.

Do I need to bring anything?

Come comfortably. Everything needed for the treatment is prepared for you in the room.

When is the total confirmed?

The booking experience confirms the selected ritual and total before you finalize the appointment.
